# Included dependencies

- Three.js 0.170.0, MIT. Installed from the npm `three` release. License: `three/LICENSE`.
- @mediapipe/face_mesh 0.4.1633559619, Apache-2.0. Installed from the npm package with the JavaScript, WASM, graph and model data supplied by Google. License: `mediapipe/LICENSE`; package metadata: `mediapipe/package.json`.

No CDN is used at runtime. Versions are pinned in this bundle.
